cadence: three articles per week — Monday, Wednesday, Friday, 12:00 Europe/Paris
rules: Choose the topic, do not take the head of the queue. Before each article, pick from the unwritten topics in content/topics.json (python3 scripts/next-topic.py --list) using these criteria, in this order: (1) what readers already read — the neighbours of articles that produced blog_read_complete and blog_product_click in PostHog; (2) what is searched but unanswered — queries the product site is seen for without ranking, which an article can claim; (3) which tag is one article short of MIN_POSTS_FOR_INDEX, turning a noindex tag page into an indexable one. Write the criterion used in the commit body — one sentence, why this topic now. Never catch up: if a slot was missed, the next article is simply the next scheduled one. See content/AUTHORING.md.
